rules: Imagine is only for a photoreal hero metaphor of THIS mechanism. No text in the Imagine prompt.
All Traditional Chinese, 金句, captions, badges are composited later. Never ask the video model to write Chinese.
Teaching beats are dark-navy motion-graphics slides: cross-section, heatmap, 金句 card.
Never search electricity / lightning / 電力 / 電工 stock.
Episode grammar: 現場問題 → 機制圖 → 金句 → 實務取捨.
金句 is one punchy sentence that is also the title.
If a real photo/SEM exists (NIST, datasheet), use it labeled 關聯實拍. Do not replace it with AI.
